prompt:
Rewrite snippets/warranty-status-2.liquid so it renders a warranty status badge exactly as specified. Inputs (only one top-level variable): - `warranty`: object or null. When it is an object, all four fields are always present: - `warranty.product_name`: string or null. - `warranty.months`: integer or null. This is the total warranty length in months. - `warranty.months_used`: integer or null. Null means 0. - `warranty.registered`: boolean, never null. Rules: 1. If `warranty` is null, output nothing (empty string). Do not access any field when warranty is null. 2. Display name: `product_name` with leading and trailing whitespace stripped. If it is null or becomes empty after stripping, use `Unnamed product`. The name must be HTML-escaped. 3. Status. Evaluate these checks in this exact order: - If `registered` is false: slug `unregistered`, label `Unregistered`. This applies even when months is null. - Else if `months` is null or less than or equal to 0: slug `none`, label `No coverage`. - Otherwise compute remaining = months - months_used, with null months_used treated as 0. - If remaining <= 0: slug `expired`, label `Expired`. - Else if remaining <= 3: slug `expiring`, label `Expiring soon`. - Else: slug `active`, label `Active`. 4. Output must be a single line with no whitespace between tags: `

NAME

LABEL

REMAINING
` REMAINING is present only for the slugs `active` and `expiring`. It is `

N months left

`, where N is the remaining count. Use `month` (singular) when N is 1, for example `

1 month left

`. For every other slug, REMAINING is omitted entirely. Example: product_name "Stand Mixer", months 24, months_used 10, registered true renders `

Stand Mixer

Active

14 months left

`. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/warranty-status-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
